records.rationale: The complete description is only a support channel, not meaningful functionality from which AI presence or absence can be assessed; forced best judgment is non-AI.
records.conflict_response: The text identifies only email support and supplies no offering functionality. I retain a weak, forced non-AI judgment; matching proposals do not cure the missing evidence.

records.rationale: The phrase does not say what is modeled or how; modeling could be conventional or AI-related, so the best binary judgment is forced non-AI with weak evidence.
records.conflict_response: The phrase names no model method, use, or AI signal, and cannot resolve whether AI is involved. I preserve the forced weak judgment rather than infer a conventional implementation.

records.rationale: The description explains conventional enterprise-architecture capture and modeling: repositories of data/metadata and lifecycle artifacts, represented relationships, and investment decisions. It describes no AI functionality.
evidence_spans: They provide a central repository to capture data and metadata about the artifacts
EA tools help with investment decisions
records.conflict_response: The EA description meaningfully specifies repositories, artifact relationships, lifecycles, and investment decisions as conventional functions, supporting non-AI. The quoted fragments are exact contiguous substrings with no embedded line breaks omitted; this remains one annotation for the shared identical description, not separate source-reference judgments.

records.rationale: The description explicitly attributes pattern identification and accurate forecasting to embedded artificial-intelligence and machine-learning algorithms, establishing an AI signal for this application.
records.ai_type_rationale: Although the text calls it a workforce-management suite, its specific functions here—pattern identification, forecasting, and reporting—are presented as leveraging embedded AI/ML. It does not establish meaningful conventional core functionality that remains without AI; native is the best-supported subtype, but the core-dependence distinction remains uncertain.
evidence_spans: By leveraging embedded artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, users can identify patterns, develop accurate forecasts and generate a variety of reports.
ai_type_evidence_spans: By leveraging embedded artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms, users can identify patterns, develop accurate forecasts and generate a variety of reports.
records.conflict_response: The suite label alone does not establish conventional functionality independent of AI, and the concrete functions are expressly tied to embedded algorithms. I therefore do not retain enabled merely from the workforce-management category; AI-native is the best forced subtype, with weak subtype evidence because dependence is not conclusively stated. Binary AI remains supported.

records.rationale: The description is only the broad phrase 'Programming Language' and gives no meaningful functionality or AI signal; non-AI is a forced best judgment.
records.conflict_response: The exact supplied text remains only 'Programming Language'; it does not specify functionality or establish an AI signal. The judgment remains weak/forced, not supported by repeated agreement or outside source identity.

records.rationale: The description expressly attributes automatic safe/unsafe driving-behavior measurement to the offering's AI technology, an affirmative product-specific signal. The appended location-services statement does not negate that AI mention.
records.ai_type_rationale: The driving-behavior measurement described is directly performed by AI, but a separate location-specific-services claim appears with no explanation of its relation to that function. AI-native best fits the explicit AI-centered function, though the overall core scope is ambiguous.
evidence_spans: Our patented artificial intelligence (AI) technology measures safe and unsafe driving behaviors automatically, right from a driver's smartphone.
Provider of location specific services thru Map-Quest.
ai_type_evidence_spans: Our patented artificial intelligence (AI) technology measures safe and unsafe driving behaviors automatically, right from a driver's smartphone.
Provider of location specific services thru Map-Quest.
records.conflict_response: The AI-driving measurement is explicitly presented as a service function, so binary AI is supported; the location-specific-services fragment does not state whether it is the same core or an unrelated additional description. Because that conventional-sounding service's connection and significance are unresolved, native is weak/forced rather than certified as a supported subtype.

records.rationale: The description expressly names machine learning technologies for automatically identifying, classifying, and extracting unstructured document content, supporting AI positively.
records.ai_type_rationale: The text first names document capture, recognition, classification, and extraction, then specifically attributes automatic identification/classification/extraction to NLP, text analytics, and ML. It does not establish which meaningful core functions remain conventionally without those technologies; AI-native is the best-supported subtype with unresolved evidence.
evidence_spans: Its natural language processing, text analytics and machine learning technologies automatically identify, classify and extract content from unstructured or variable documents.
ai_type_evidence_spans: Its natural language processing, text analytics and machine learning technologies automatically identify, classify and extract content from unstructured or variable documents.
streamline the capture, recognition and classification of business documents and extract important information
records.conflict_response: The text supports AI because ML is expressly used for automatic document identification, classification, and extraction. But the opening sentence establishes capture/extraction as offering functions without saying those conventional functions remain meaningfully available independently of the specified ML; nor does the later sentence prove AI dependence of every function. I resolve this as AI-native with weak/forced subtype, not an unsupported enabled default.
